_note: Written by scripts/process-images.mjs ('images'). 'alt' = image descriptions (from Albada_Product_Images.pdf). 'gallery' = extra photos shown on the product page. Add an id to 'illustrative' to show 'Illustrative image' on it. 'versions' = bump a number when a photo is replaced, so cached copies (kept for a day) are not shown.
